title: Roamhaven Rewards Bonus Credit Schedule
content:
Roamhaven Rewards grants two kinds of bonus credit on top of the tier earn: a **Superhost-stay bonus** on a stay, and a **tier-upgrade bonus** in a status year. Each is booked on the member's credit statement as its own bonus entry, separate from the credits earned on the stay.

## Superhost-stay bonus

0.50 percent of the stay's eligible spend is added when the stay's host account was Superhost on the check-out date. The figure is the same on every tier.

| Tier | Superhost-stay bonus (percent of eligible spend) |
|---|---|
| Rewards Member | 0.50 |
| Rewards Silver | 0.50 |
| Rewards Gold | 0.50 |
| Rewards Platinum | 0.50 |
| Rewards Diamond | 0.50 |
| Rewards Ambassador | 0.50 |

## Tier-upgrade bonus

A fixed number of credits is granted once when the member first reaches the tier in a status year.

| Tier reached | Tier-upgrade bonus (credits) |
|---|---|
| Rewards Member | 0.00 |
| Rewards Silver | 10.00 |
| Rewards Gold | 25.00 |
| Rewards Platinum | 50.00 |
| Rewards Diamond | 100.00 |
| Rewards Ambassador | 200.00 |

## How bonuses combine (all tiers)

The tier earn, the Superhost-stay bonus and any promotional bonus are added together.

*Hypothetical illustration:* for a member whose tier earn rate is 2.50 percent, a stay hosted by a host account that was Superhost on the check-out date is credited at 2.50 percent and 0.50 percent added together, that is 3.00 percent of eligible spend, booked as two entries: the credits earned and the Superhost-stay bonus.

## Points of reading

- The Superhost-stay bonus turns on the host account's tier on the check-out date.
- The tier-upgrade bonus is tied to the tier reached; reaching Rewards Member carries no upgrade bonus (0.00 credits).
